steps.content: [Black Screen + Steam]
A gentle warmth cocoons her. Within it, two sensations emerge: the distant murmur of a classical piece entwined with water, and the rich, floral perfume of steam.
Swathed in this quiet luxury, Hypatia's awareness stirs. Slowly, her eyelids part.
[Scene: Luxury Hotel]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...! Where... where am I...?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: You're awake, Hypatia.
[CG]
It is her, the woman from the dream. She sits framed by steam, towels and delicate bottles of oil arranged beside her like offerings. Through the scented haze, her smile is a soft, familiar beacon.

Margaret Kervoz. The name carries weight in Fraser, a society she has charmed and navigated with an outsider's grace. Born into DisCity's high society, she has spent years cultivating an image of gentle attentiveness and impeccable diplomacy, accumulating considerable wealth and prestige.

Her empire of influence spans charity, social activism, finance, and art. Her newest title—DisCity's Outland Affairs Officer—marks her as an official "peace ambassador," a role that makes even the Fraser Senate deeply uneasy.

Margaret seems physiologically incapable of anger; her patience is a deep, still lake. Throughout their entire acquaintance, Hypatia has seen that perfect composure break only once. It was at the very nadir of Hypatia's confusion, when Margaret's voice, usually so soft, turned to cold, hammered steel with the command: "Listen to me."

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ms. Margaret...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Rest easy. This hotel is my private property. No one will disturb us here.
A warm towel blankets Hypatia's brow. Beside her, Margaret gently wipes away the cold evidence of the nightmare.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: After you were taken by the Senate, I searched everywhere for you. It was no easy task to learn where they were holding you, and when I finally rushed there, I found you collapsed by the roadside... Thank goodness I was able to bring you out in time.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: You had multiple injuries and were in severe psychological distress, so I decided to bring you here to tend to your wounds and give you a therapeutic bath.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: On my recent trip to Eastia, I brought back some local medicinal herbs. They say when used in aromatherapy, they can soothe the mind... How do you feel now? Is your head still hurting?
Belatedly, Hypatia realizes she is immersed in warm water. It cradles her, finding each hurt—first a sharp protest, then a softening release.
Yet, the echoes of her dream cling to her, a lingering tremor of pain and confusion. She lets her eyes fall shut, as if to seal the waking world out.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'm all right. I apologize; I should have escaped on my own, but for some reason... Though everything went smoothly at first, after leaving the hotel, in that moment I just...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: This isn't your fault. Physical depletion, psychological torment... these are their standard methods.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ugh...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Look, your left shoulder and knee are dislocated, and there are countless abrasions and contusions... They must have been ordered to torture you without leaving visible marks on your skin.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Of course, the most egregious part is...
Margaret hands her a mirror. Hypatia takes it and raises it to her neck. There, on its lower back, is a faint mark she knows was not there before.
[Show Special Portrait: Underground Brand]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...It appears to be the new invention from the Luminaris Society and the Underground. I never expected it would be used on me so soon.
When had it been branded? She had felt nothing.
Her fingers rise of their own accord, tracing the edges of the still-unhealed mark.
[The mark glows]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Gasp...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Silly girl, why would you touch it?

A ladle of warm water pours steadily over her neck. Hypatia feels a warmth that travels not just over her skin, but into the brand itself, as though following its lines. Then, the ache gradually lifts, bleeding away.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ms. Margaret... what is...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: My power cannot remove it completely, but it can alleviate its flare-ups to some extent. To eliminate it entirely will require time... and your own willpower.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I'm sorry. I failed to protect you, which allowed them to exploit the situation and subject you to this suffering.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: They falsely accused you of colluding with DisCity, hoping to use your own words to undermine our efforts for peace.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: But your courage and wisdom far exceeded my expectations. Even when pushed to the limits of mental endurance, you still refused to yield to them.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No, it was nothing...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's just that... I had intended to resolve this matter myself, but in the end, I still dragged you into it...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Don't worry. I have my own methods of negotiation. Dealing with them isn't a challenge for me.
Margaret winks with casual confidence.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Fraser plans to hold a victory celebration in a few days to reassure its farland allies. As DisCity's peace ambassador, I will naturally be expected to give a speech.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: For such an important occasion, they have been remarkably cooperative lately, afraid I might say something I shouldn't.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: The Senate had no legitimate grounds to arrest you, so they resorted to illegal evidence gathering and untraceable torture methods, hoping to provoke you into violence. Then they could use that as leverage to fabricate charges against you.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: They need a scapegoat before the celebration, someone to blame for their defeat and to placate the farlands. But they lack the courage to refuse my request, or to openly confront me and take you back.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Since that's the case, I simply have to seize the opportunity and make them swallow their loss without a word of complaint.
Despite Margaret's confident tone, Hypatia knows the reality in Fraser is far harsher.

Since the war began, Disians like Margaret have faced open hostility and systemic discrimination. As a prominent figure, Margaret encounters obstacles at every turn. And now, she must spend her dwindling political capital to...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Hm?
Margaret notices her concern, leans down, and gives her a gentle hug.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Don't worry, Hypatia. When I made this choice, I was fully aware of its cost and its risks.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: We have long been important collaborators, friends, even comrades... You risked assassination to intercept communications between the research institute and Fraser, then worked tirelessly to decrypt that data. You helped us stop BR-005 just in time, ending the war early and preventing the calamities in the farlands from worsening.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Had BR-005 remained active, with Apostles striking DisSea, today's devastation would be far more severe... As a scientist, you understand this better than I do. After what you have done for DisCity and for peace, you deserve everything I am doing for you now.
She rises to her feet and retrieves clean clothes from nearby.
[CG Ends, Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: That's enough for now. Come out and get dressed. Stay in any longer, and the water will grow cold.
[Scene: Hotel]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Stay here tonight. Forget the nightmares, forget the worries. They are merely illusions the enemy uses to torment you. Do not let them haunt you.
Margaret takes an ivory comb from a golden tray nearby and gently ties Hypatia's long hair.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Tonight, at least, you need not think of anything. Simply rest and regain your strength. Whatever may come, I will be right here by your side.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: The Senate will not risk a diplomatic incident by barging in here. Besides, I have a capable friend who can keep us safe.

The moment Margaret falls silent, a grey-haired woman enters. Her gaze moves across the room—assessing, swift—and settles on Hypatia. It lingers on the girl's blonde hair and mismatched eyes for several telling seconds before she coolly looks away.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Ma'am, you asked for me?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Allow me to introduce Helga. Officially, she serves as my bodyguard, but in truth, she is a representative of the Farland Alliance, sent to gauge Fraser's stance toward the farlands. She is also a formidable warrior.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Helga, this is Hypatia Campbell, whom I've mentioned to you many times, the kindest and strongest girl I've ever met.
Helga's gaze is a blade, sharp and cold. Her weathered face, etched by wind and conflict, is startlingly familiar; it calls to mind the farlanders' shadowy figures from Hypatia's own dream.
Instinctively, Hypatia lowers her head, unable to hold the woman's gray stare.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: A pleasure to meet you. I'm Hypatia Campbell... Thank you for your protection.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Hello, I'm Helga.

In the thick, uncomfortable silence that follows, only Margaret maintains a composed, sweet smile. She appears quietly satisfied, as if the two's frigid first encounter has unfolded exactly to her liking.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Look at us, representatives from DisCity, the farlands, and Fraser. Wouldn't it be wonderful if the current political climate could reflect the same spirit of understanding and peaceful coexistence as our little gathering here?
